title: Blueprint.Relationships
description:
Relationships that link a Blueprint to related resources.

Introduced in Apple Business API 2.6.

apps.description: The apps associated with this Blueprint.

configurations.description: The configurations associated with this Blueprint.

orgDevices.description: The devices associated with this Blueprint.

packages.description: The packages associated with this Blueprint.

userGroups.description: The user groups associated with this Blueprint.

users.description: The users associated with this Blueprint.
